
====================
FULL OPCODES LIST
====================

Format:
HEX BIN AAA BBB CC INSTR

--- ALU (CC=00) ---
00 00000000 000 000 00 ADC #imm
04 00000100 000 001 00 ADC abs
08 00001000 000 010 00 ADC abs+B
0C 00001100 000 011 00 ADC abs+C
10 00010000 000 100 00 ADC [DC]
14 00010100 000 101 00 ADC [ptr]
18 00011000 000 110 00 ADC [ptr]+B
1C 00011100 000 111 00 ADC [DC+B]

20 00100000 001 000 00 SBB #imm
24 00100100 001 001 00 SBB abs
28 00101000 001 010 00 SBB abs+B
2C 00101100 001 011 00 SBB abs+C
30 00110000 001 100 00 SBB [DC]
34 00110100 001 101 00 SBB [ptr]
38 00111000 001 110 00 SBB [ptr]+B
3C 00111100 001 111 00 SBB [DC+B]

40 01000000 010 000 00 AND #imm
44 01000100 010 001 00 AND abs
48 01001000 010 010 00 AND abs+B
4C 01001100 010 011 00 AND abs+C
50 01010000 010 100 00 AND [DC]
54 01010100 010 101 00 AND [ptr]
58 01011000 010 110 00 AND [ptr]+B
5C 01011100 010 111 00 AND [DC+B]

60 01100000 011 000 00 ORA #imm
64 01100100 011 001 00 ORA abs
68 01101000 011 010 00 ORA abs+B
6C 01101100 011 011 00 ORA abs+C
70 01110000 011 100 00 ORA [DC]
74 01110100 011 101 00 ORA [ptr]
78 01111000 011 110 00 ORA [ptr]+B
7C 01111100 011 111 00 ORA [DC+B]

80 10000000 100 000 00 XOR #imm
84 10000100 100 001 00 XOR abs
88 10001000 100 010 00 XOR abs+B
8C 10001100 100 011 00 XOR abs+C
90 10010000 100 100 00 XOR [DC]
94 10010100 100 101 00 XOR [ptr]
98 10011000 100 110 00 XOR [ptr]+B
9C 10011100 100 111 00 XOR [DC+B]

A0 10100000 101 000 00 CMP #imm
A4 10100100 101 001 00 CMP abs
A8 10101000 101 010 00 CMP abs+B
AC 10101100 101 011 00 CMP abs+C
B0 10110000 101 100 00 CMP [DC]
B4 10110100 101 101 00 CMP [ptr]
B8 10111000 101 110 00 CMP [ptr]+B
BC 10111100 101 111 00 CMP [DC+B]

C0 11000000 110 000 00 CPB #imm
C4 11000100 110 001 00 CPB abs
C8 11001000 110 010 00 CPB abs+B
CC 11001100 110 011 00 CPB abs+C
D0 11010000 110 100 00 CPB [DC]
D4 11010100 110 101 00 CPB [ptr]
D8 11011000 110 110 00 CPB [ptr]+B
DC 11011100 110 111 00 CPB [DC+B]

E0 11100000 111 000 00 CPC #imm
E4 11100100 111 001 00 CPC abs
E8 11101000 111 010 00 CPC abs+B
EC 11101100 111 011 00 CPC abs+C
F0 11110000 111 100 00 CPC [DC]
F4 11110100 111 101 00 CPC [ptr]
F8 11111000 111 110 00 CPC [ptr]+B
FC 11111100 111 111 00 CPC [DC+B]


--- MEMORY (CC=01) ---
01 00000001 000 000 01 LDA #imm

0D 00001101 000 011 01 LDA abs+C

15 00010101 000 101 01 LDA [ptr]

1D 00011101 000 111 01 LDA [DC+B]

4D 01001101 010 011 01 LDC abs+C

5D 01011101 010 111 01 LDC [DC+B]

71 01110001 011 100 01 LDD [DC]

7D 01111101 011 111 01 LDD [DC+B]

95 10010101 100 101 01 STA [ptr]

B5 10110101 101 101 01 STB [ptr]

C5 11000101 110 001 01 STC abs

CD 11001101 110 011 01 STC abs+C

D5 11010101 110 101 01 STC [ptr]
D9 11011001 110 110 01 STC [ptr]+B
DD 11011101 110 111 01 STC [DC+B]

E1 11100001 111 000 01 STD #imm (Invalid)
E5 11100101 111 001 01 STD abs
E9 11101001 111 010 01 STD abs+B
ED 11101101 111 011 01 STD abs+C

F5 11110101 111 101 01 STD [ptr]
F9 11111001 111 110 01 STD [ptr]+B
FD 11111101 111 111 01 STD [DC+B]

--- FLOW (CC=10) ---
02 00000010 000 000 10 JMP abs
06 00000110 000 001 10 JMP ZF,abs
0A 00001010 000 010 10 JMP NZ,abs
0E 00001110 000 011 10 JMP NF,abs
12 00010010 000 100 10 JMP NN,abs
16 00010110 000 101 10 JMP CF,abs
1A 00011010 000 110 10 JMP NC,abs
1E 00011110 000 111 10 JMP VF,abs

26 00100110 001 001 10 JSR ZF,abs
2A 00101010 001 010 10 JSR NZ,abs
2E 00101110 001 011 10 JSR NF,abs

--- SPECIAL (CC=11) ---
--- MOV ---
03 00000011 000 000 11 MOV A→B
07 00000111 000 001 11 MOV A→C
0B 00001011 000 010 11 MOV A→D
0F 00001111 000 011 11 MOV B→A
13 00010011 000 100 11 MOV C→A
17 00010111 000 101 11 MOV D→A
1B 00011011 000 110 11 MOV B→C
1F 00011111 000 111 11 MOV C→B

37 00110111 001 101 11 (reservado)
3B 00111011 001 110 11 (reservado)
3F 00111111 001 111 11 (reservado)

4F 01001111 010 011 11 DEC D

57 01010111 010 101 11 (reservado)
5B 01011011 010 110 11 (reservado)
5F 01011111 010 111 11 (reservado)

--- SHIFT / ROTATE ---
63 01100011 011 000 11 SHL A
67 01100111 011 001 11 SHR A
6B 01101011 011 010 11 ROL A
6F 01101111 011 011 11 ROR A
73 01110011 011 100 11 SHL B
77 01110111 011 101 11 SHR B
7B 01111011 011 110 11 ROL B
7F 01111111 011 111 11 ROR B

83 10000011 100 000 11 NEG A
87 10000111 100 001 11 NEG B
8B 10001011 100 010 11 NEG C
8F 10001111 100 011 11 NEG D
93 10010011 100 100 11 CLR A
97 10010111 100 101 11 CLR B
9B 10011011 100 110 11 CLR C
9F 10011111 100 111 11 CLR D
